Bill.BriefDescription: Changing provisions relating to equal access and opportunity in public employment, public education, and public contracting.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to equal access and opportunity in publicemployment, public education, and public contracting; and repealing RCW49.60.400 and 49.60.401.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 49.60.400 (Discrimination, preferential treatmentprohibited) and 1999 c 3 s 1; and RCW 49.60.401 (Short title1999 c 3) and 1999 c 3 s 2.
